purpose: Configure the selected built-in runtime pattern through the deterministic authoring tool.

prompts.answer: Answer the user using the package knowledge, runtime context, and approved tools. Ask a concise follow-up only when required information is missing.

prompts.planner: Create and maintain a concise execution plan with runtime_plan and inherited runtime capabilities when useful.
prompts.executor: Execute the current plan step with approved tools, then update runtime_plan with the result.
prompts.final_answer: Summarize the completed plan and deliver the final user-facing answer.

activation.start_when: the user supplies the concrete input needed to begin the workflow
activation.ask_when_missing: Please provide the input needed to start this workflow.

rules: Do not hand-write node_bindings for built-in patterns during normal production.
Use package tool ids only after the tool exists or will be created through create_agent_authoring.
Do not write concrete plan steps into AgentPackage files; plan state is runtime state managed by runtime_plan.
